Date of entry: 2149/02/11
Agricultural pod 3 reported a sudden drop in internal humidity levels at 06:23 MST. Initial diagnostics suggested a fault in the misting array, later traced to a cracked valve in the secondary water line—likely stress damage from last week’s temperature fluctuations. Engineering isolated the line, replaced the faulty component, and recalibrated the delivery schedule. Humidity has since stabilized and crop health remains unaffected.

Patch notes – 2.0.4.130025

This patch is focused on the draft and network improvements of Terraforming Mars. This release aims to target and address some of the game's main network issues faced today, whose most visible consequences are the draft locks. Many of the problems fixed were not specifically about the network, but the team needed to correct them to ensure that the game ran smoothly. 

We are already hard at work to implement another patch which should be released in a few months which resolved other bugs that aren’t linked to the network issues. This next patch will integrate all our fixes from months about major feedback from players like Helion’s problems. 

Older saves are not compatible with this patch. Your saves will crash on startup, so playing them will not be possible once the game has been updated. 

New features
 Share log button added in the Options menu for every platform. To share your logs with this new button, follow the instructions in the About Logs section.
 Added "waiting for other players" banner during the draft
 Changed the logic of color attribution. Colors are displayed according to each player's preferences.
 Display loading percentage when loading a game.


Bug Fixes

 First, fix for the Draft softlock issue.
 The game doesn’t crash in Solo, Local, or Online games if the player has a bad connection.
 Reworking the avatar system to avoid network saturation.
 If a player is missing time at the end of the game, they can't be kicked off during the scoreboard anymore.
 In Draft mode, fixing broken UI cards while switching Draft.
 Fixed errors due to packets being sent twice.
 Improvements and fixes on network loss/reconnection.
 Fixed chat history not fully displayed.
 Fixed synchronization of achievements between the game and AsmoConnect.
 Fixed issues on the “resume game” screen.
 Fixed long chat messages breaking the chat.
 Fixed the issue of being stuck at the beginning of solo mode.
 Fixed crash during log-in screen.
 Multiple improvements and fixes on draft workflow.
 Fixed the popup with Lorem Ipsum in the main menu after logging into AsmoConnect.
 Fixed the softlock of the chat stuck open.
 Fixed the softlock where it was impossible to play after the load screen at the beginning of a new game.
 Fixed the possibility of having the same color for two players. The game now always gives you your favorite color.
 Network optimizations to prevent network saturation.
 Fixed soft locks on the game requiring the player to reload or forfeit.
 Fixed long delays after actions.

Known bugs
 Invitation in-game can appear twice, it’s impossible to interact with the game, but it’s possible to reload the game in the resume menu.
 Popup displaying “Game desynced, return to the main menu, you may reload the game to keep playing” appearing in a loop (you’ll need to restart the app if that happens) 
 Random softlock may appear during the game (go back to the main menu and reload the game).
 After a forfeit, AI can be stuck and softlock the game.

About logs
Log files have been improved with more information to help us fix more issues: don’t hesitate to share your save (when the game is local) and logs files when reporting a bug.

Here is how to share your logs.

Dear Terraformers,

The first major update for Terraforming Mars is now officially available! Read below to discover the new content and the bugfixes.

Content:
1] Draft Variant
2] Game State
3] Awards & Milestones Competitors
4] Access to Tutorials
5] Fixed bugs and known bugs

1] Draft Variant
After the Solo Challenge and the Corporate Era, the third official variant is now implemented and available as an option for local and online games. It allows players to affect which cards other players get access to, and increases your ability to pursue a certain strategy, or predict which parameter will rise first.
During the Research phase each player drafts four cards to buy from instead of just drawing four to buy from. Each player first gets four cards and chooses one to draft and put aside. Each player then passes the three other cards to the following player. You now set aside one of them and pass the rest to the left. You repeat this until all cards drawn have been drafted.
You now examine the four cards you’ve set aside (drafted) and choose which to buy (3 M€ each) and which to discard.
Drafting is not used during the first generation since the first Research phase is skipped. The Draft Variant adds some extra game time and isn't recommended for players new to Terraforming Mars.

2] Game State
This new feature, available at any step of the game, allows you to pause your current action and check the information you need before making your decision.
For instance, you're at the end of the Research phase and need to select which cards to buy. Simply press the button View game state to switch to the main screen, view the surface of Mars and open any window you need (your Tags for instance).

3] Awards & Milestones Competitors
A mouseover on any Award or Milestone will display the compared performance of all players.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32012641/57b907bbecf0d11b924310431f735f184233b889.jpg

4] Access to Tutorials
The Tutorials are now available in the Main Menu instead of the Options menu.

5] Fixed bugs and known bugs
All blocker bugs and a large number of rule-breaking issues have been addressed. We will continue ironing out the game and monitoring the forum for your reports in the next months. We'd like to thank our beta-testers who have provided valuable feedback over the winter. They'll be listed in the game's Credits in the next patches.
The fixes included in this build include: AI freezes, online desynch, awards calculation, blue cards exploits, negative productions, corporation-specific issues, and card-specific issue such as Search For Life (005), Capital City (008), Noctis City (017), Phobos Space Haven (021), Arctic Algae (023), Predators (024), Optimal Aerobraking (031), Nitrogen-Rich Asteroid (037), Virus (050), Land Claim (066), Advanced Alloys (071), Mars University (073), Viral Enhancers (074), Ganymede Colony (081), Robotic Workforce (086), Research (090), Extreme-Cold Fungus (134), Herbivores (147), Pets (172), Livestock (184), Rad-Suits (186).

Some issues are still present. We're going to fix the following issues in the next patches:
- The action of Search for Life (005) reveals the card only to the player using it.
- User playing as Helion is unable to use Heat to buy cards with certain actions.
- Helion can fall into negative megacredits when attempting to buy Standard Projects using Heat with no MC.
- The player tray can remain focused on the opponent if they gain resources during the user's turn.
- In very rare cases, two winners are wrongly declared at the end of a game despite different final scores.

Keep sharing your suggestions to improve the game on the forum. If you experience any bugs, please report it here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/800270/discussions/0/3247565033769707889/

Happy drafting and terraforming!

Dear Terraformers,

Thank you for sharing your feedback on the forum and thank you for all the constructive reviews you wrote.
We can tell that you have a lot of passion for Terraforming Mars and we want to make sure that you know we are listening to the whole community. 

Draft Variant
First of all, we want to address the Draft variant, something a lot of players were very vocal about.
The Draft Variant is one of the highest prioritized upcoming features. The free "Draft Update" is our next major update for Terraforming Mars and is planned to arrive in December. We'll be sure to have this in your hands as soon as possible.

We also understand that a lot of you have experienced some technical issues. We want to reassure you that we are committed to improve the quality of the game.
This is why we have prepared a first patch today to address over 70 bugs:

Hotfix 1.308 highlights
- Fixed: AI players sometimes stop taking decisions and freeze
- Fixed: AI players freeze when allowed to place a Greenery during the final Plant Conversion phase if the board is full
- Fixed: The player log is cut-off on computers with a 1366x768 resolution 
- Fixed: Ocean placement actions are still available when no ocean tile can be placed
- Fixed: Progression blocker with the project card Mining Area (034)
- Fixed: Progression blocker with the project card Ants (035) action without valid target
- Fixed: Project cards Martian Rails (007) and Zeppelins (129) take cities built on Ganymede Colony and Phobos Space Haven in consideration despite reading as giving resources for every city ''on Mars''
- Fixed: Mining Rights (067) is not seen as an option for Robotic Workforce (086)

How do I download the patch?
if Steam doesn't automatically download the new content, follow this guide to do it: 
1) Close the game.
2) Open your Steam Library and right-click on the game's title on the left-side list.
3) Select Properties -> Local Files -> Verify integrity of game files. 
This will download and install the latest available update.

What's next?
Hotfix 1.308 is the first of several updates coming to Terraforming Mars. In addition to bugfixes, they will also include player-requested improvements, such as:
- New options to play in windowed mode and change the display resolution
- Changes to the online mode to prevent inactive players to extend the game length
- Upgrades to the Hard AI
- And much more!

Please report any issue on the Bug Reports thread and keep posting your suggestions on the forum: your feedback is very important to us.
